title: Raised Cosine Transmit Filter
text: Apply pulse shaping by interpolating signal using raised cosine FIR filter, 1 input, 1 output, {Output} sets Output data type Inherit: Same as; {Filter shape}, {Rolloff factor} sets the roll-off factor, {Filter span in symbols}, {Output samples per symbol} sets the number of output samples per symbol, {Linear amplitude filter gain} sets the linear filter gain, {Input processing}, {Rate options} sets the block processing rate Enforce single-rate, {Export filter coefficients to workspace}, {Coefficient variable name} sets the name of coefficient, {View Filter Response} sets the open Filter Visualization, {Rounding mode}, {Saturate on integer overflow} sets the overflow mode for fixed-point operations, {Coefficients} sets the coefficient data type, {Product output}, {Accumulator} and {Lock data type settings against changes by the fixed-point tools} prevents fixed-point tools from overriding data. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: In
ports.summary: Input signal scalar | column vector | matrix

ports.name: Out
ports.summary: Output signal scalar | column vector | matrix

params.name: Filter span in symbols
params.values: Filter span in symbols 10 (default) | even positive integer

params.name: Output samples per symbol
params.values: Number of output samples per symbol 8 (default) | integer greater than 1

params.name: Input processing
params.values: Input processing control Columns as channels (frame based) (default) | Elements as channels (sample based)

params.name: Rate options
params.values: Block processing rate Enforce single-rate processing (default) | Allow multirate processing

params.name: Rounding mode
params.values: Rounding mode for fixed-point operations Floor (default) | Ceiling | Convergent | Nearest | Round | Simplest | Zero

params.name: Saturate on integer overflow
params.values: Overflow mode for fixed-point operations off (default) | on

params.name: Coefficients
params.values: Coefficient data type Inherit: Same word length as input (default) | fixdt(1,16) | fixdt(1,16,0)

params.name: Product output
params.values: Product output data type Inherit: Inherit via internal rule (default) | Inherit: Same as input | fixdt(1,16,0)

params.name: Accumulator
params.values: Accumulator data type Inherit: Inherit via internal rule (default) | Inherit: Same as input | Inherit: Same as product output | fixdt(1,16,0)

params.name: Output
params.values: Output data type Inherit: Same as accumulator (default) | Inherit: Same as input | Inherit: Same as product output | fixdt(1,16,0)

params.name: Lock data type settings against changes by the fixed-point tools
params.values: Prevent fixed-point tools from overriding data types off (default) | on
